origin: "Combo" means combination: it combines a box for typing (a text box) with a list for choosing (a list box).
whenToUse: Lists with many options, such as cities, companies, or people.
People know part of the name they're looking for.
People need to choose quickly with the keyboard.
whenNotToUse: There are only a few options (use a select or a radio group).
People must freely enter values not in the list (add suggestions to a text field).
People choose several (use a multi-select or a tag input).

alternatives.name: Search Field
alternatives.reason: Filtering a list rather than choosing from it.

accessibility: Follow the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern with role="combobox", aria-expanded, and aria-controls.
Options moved through with ↑/↓ are announced with aria-activedescendant while focus stays in the input.
Enter chooses, Esc closes the list, and pressing Esc again clears the input.
Skip key handling during Korean input composition so characters aren't cut off.
